title: The Deposit
setting: 10am. Krishnamurthy uncle's verandah. A glass of filter coffee in front of you. Rangaswamy is leaning against the gatepost, finally off his phone. The paperwork sits on a low wooden stool between you.

beats.native: ಸಾರ್, ರಾತ್ರಿ ಯೋಚಿಸಿದೆ. ನಾಲ್ಕು ತಿಂಗಳ advance, twenty-two thousand rent. ಆಗುತ್ತಾ?
beats.translit: sār, rātri yōcisidde. nālku tiṅgaḷa advance, twenty-two thousand rent. āguttā?
beats.en: Sir, I thought about it last night. Four months advance, twenty-two thousand rent. Works for you?
beats.beat: meeting you halfway already — six down to four

beats.native: ಸಾರ್, four months ತುಂಬಾ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿದೆ. Owners ಎಲ್ಲ ten ಕೇಳ್ತಾರೆ ಇಂದು. Sign ಮಾಡಿ ಸಾರ್.
beats.translit: sār, four months tumbā cennāgide. Owners ella ten kēḷtāre indu. sign māḍi sār.
beats.en: Sir, four months is very good. Owners all ask for ten these days. Sign sir.
beats.beat: leaning forward — his commission is in the room

beats.prompt: You take a sip of coffee. You say:

choices.native: Sir, ನಾಲ್ಕು ತಿಂಗಳ ಒಪ್ಪಿಗೆ. ಆದರೆ rent twenty thousand ಆದರೆ ಆಗುತ್ತಾ? Two thousand discount.
choices.translit: sir, nālku tiṅgaḷa oppige. ādare rent twenty thousand ādare āguttā? two thousand discount.
choices.en: Sir, four months agreed. But could we do twenty thousand rent? Two-thousand discount.

choices.native: ಸಾರ್, ನಾಲ್ಕು ತಿಂಗಳ ಒಪ್ಪಿಗೆ. Sign ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.
choices.translit: sār, nālku tiṅgaḷa oppige. sign māḍtīni.
choices.en: Sir, four months agreed. I'll sign.
Could we revisit the rent number?

beats.native: Twenty-one thousand. ನನ್ನ final ಸಾರ್. ಒಂದು sahi ಇಲ್ಲಿ, ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಇಲ್ಲಿ.
beats.translit: twenty-one thousand. nanna final sār. ondu sahi illi, innondu illi.
beats.en: Twenty-one thousand. My final, sir. One signature here, another here.
beats.beat: slides the agreement across. one finger taps where you sign.

beats.native: Ha, ನೋಡಿ ಸಾರ್! Uncle ತುಂಬಾ kind. Sign ಮಾಡಿ ನಂತರ key.
beats.translit: ha, nōḍi sār! uncle tumbā kind. sign māḍi nantara key.
beats.en: Ha, see sir! Uncle is very kind. Sign and then keys.
beats.beat: his commission is officially in the bag

beats.prompt: You take the pen. You say:

choices.native: ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು ಸಾರ್. Trust ಗೆ thanks. ನಾನು ಒಳ್ಳೆ tenant ಆಗಿರ್ತೀನಿ.
choices.translit: dhanyavādagaḷu sār. trust-ge thanks. nānu oḷḷe tenant āgirtīni.
choices.en: Thank you, sir. Thank you for your trust. I'll be a good tenant.

beats.native: ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದು ಸಾರ್. ಸ್ವಾಗತ. ಯಾವಾಗ ಬೇಕಾದರೂ ಬನ್ನಿ.
beats.translit: oḷḷeyadu sār. svāgata. yāvāga bēkādarū banni.
beats.en: Good, sir. Welcome. Come whenever you need anything.
beats.beat: hands you a single brass key with a faded red thread tied to it
